description: Published dyscalculia prevalence figures with sample size, publication year, age, the reference key (see get_reference) and a calc flag (true when the site calculated the figure itself). Filter by study id, by age (entries whose stated age range includes it; entries with no stated age are never matched) or by a percent range (entries whose figure or range overlaps it). With no filter, returns all 10 entries. These are published research estimates, not a diagnosis of any person. There is no worldwide pooled meta-analysis of dyscalculia prevalence: the 'worldwide' entry is a range across population studies. Studies use different criteria and ages, so figures are not directly comparable.
